data.name: MD Pool Service, Inc.
data.address: 711 W Main St Suite 142, Ovilla, TX 75154

reviews.text: So happy with this amazing pool service. Fixed my pump in a jiffy and hooked everything up! Whew! Very reasonable charge…. I will call them again when needed. Mark is a very cool guy!
reviews.author: Peggy Roberts

reviews.text: 5 stars! The absolute best, easy experience! I spent 3 weeks trying to get my pool clear— I would do water testing, spent money on chemicals and nothing would work. I finally found this company that would service our temporary above ground pool- and they turned my pool from green to blue within 2 hours! It is now clear ! I am so happy! They were so helpful and kind! I highly recommend .
reviews.author: Taylor Madu

reviews.text: Had problems with a leaking pipe during the busy part of summer. I knew most companies were booked for weeks.  I called MD pool and received a prompt response. They were out within the week and made all repairs. Excellent service.
reviews.author: David W

reviews.text: The technician came within an hour of me calling and had the problem with my pool cleaner diagnosed and fixed in an hour. Great service and very quick!
reviews.author: Ashley Loftis

reviews.text: Awesome people and very knowledgeable. I called them for help at 4 p.m., and they came out the next morning. My pump was not working correctly, and I thought I had a clogged pipe. The guys from the MD pool service came out and said that due to some construction we had in our backyard, the filters were dirty and restricting water flow. In 30 minutes, they diagnosed the problem and cleaned the filter. They also sent me photos of before and after the work was complete. Great service.
reviews.author: John Patterson

reviews.text: Alrighty everyone, had Mark come out April 22nd he did a outstanding job!  Let me just say this when its comes to pool cleaning and repair work its hard finding a reasonable  service along with quality and professionalism tailored to the customer needs. MD pools - Mark done just that ! I recommend anyone to MD pools ask for Mark.  Mark was professional , honest yet personal to my needs and repair work. Thanks Mark
reviews.author: C B

reviews.text: These guys are great. They are very knowledgeable and honest. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Eric Franco

reviews.text: Mark was knowledgeable and easy to deal with. Would deal with him again.
reviews.author: ARMANDO VILLARREAL

reviews.text: Mark was very prompt and quickly responded to my request for service when it was 24 degrees outside.  He immediately discovered my issue and reported back to me his findings at NO CHARGE!  I will continue to use MD Pool Service for all of my future pool needs!
reviews.author: Ron Neff

reviews.text: For all of those whom have had a 5 star experience, I'm happy for you. If you know nothing about a pool system, its easy to be misled. This deal just got worse as time went on for me as I had taken care of my pool for the last 25 years. Too many little things not getting addressed, fixed, or mentioned again, after me asking multiple times for them to be addressed. Then they hire another member who made several mistakes on several of my visits with him, openly told Mark about my concerns, but these issues never went away, just Mark did. I have pictures, but am not here for that, but they did more damage than good to my system, that I can promise you. Buyer beware.
reviews.author: Bill Green

reviews.text: As a real estate agent who frequently needs a reliable pool repair company for my properties, MD Pool Service has been a fantastic vendor for me. They are honest, reliable, and have good communication systems to provide quotes and updates on work  progress. I've called them in a pinch and they were able to jump right on a project that was very time sensitive. Highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Erin Frye

reviews.text: I couldn't be happier with the pool service provided by this company! They recently cleaned my pool and filter, and the results were outstanding. The water is now crystal clear, and the filter is running more efficiently than ever. The team was punctual, professional, and left no mess behind. I'm so impressed with their expertise and dedication to customer satisfaction. I'll definitely be using their services again and highly recommend them to anyone in need of top-notch pool maintenance!
reviews.author: Bryce

reviews.text:
If I could give more then 5 stars I would!

We have had several pool companies come out to “service our equipment” and look at issues we have, and each failed.  Marc came out to assess our issues and leak and blew my mind with all his knowledge on the equipment.  He came out and repaired a leak we had and upgraded our outdated service panel and was so helpful with setting up the app and getting the pool up and running again.  I HIGHLY recommend this company!
reviews.author: Amy Munn

reviews.text: Reached out to this company a few days ago via their website seeking pool cleaning services. I was hoping to receive excellent service as noted on prior google reviews. Unfortunately, I was highly disappointed in the fact that Marc came by and left my house within a matter of minutes without providing any services whatsoever. Apparently, their business is doing extremely well to the point they can turn away customers. I would not recommend them to anyone based upon my disappointing experience.
reviews.author: Fred J

reviews.text: They came every week and serviced our 2 ft buried ABOVE ground pool. It has a delicate liner and they handled it perfectly. The water 💦 stayed clear and clean the entire summer! I highly recommend MD Pool Service!
reviews.author: Kimberly Sheares

reviews.text: Wanted to Say Thank you to MD POOLS. I had pump issue late Friday afternoon I called MD POOLS… He had a tech out there same day and disgust the issue I had. Next day the tech was back out and fixing my pump… Wanted to share my experience with everyone. Marc the tech was professional and nice to speak with. He was knowledgeable on how to fix the pump and he did it in a timely fashion. Now my pump is back up and working. Thanks again MD pools for the quick response and the quick repair… I will be supporting the local business again.
reviews.author: Justin Peacock

reviews.text: We’ve been using MD pools for about a year now. Their customer service is prompt, direct and very professional. We have the same person coming every visit so we don’t have strangers on our property. Marc is great with taking his time to explain and walk me through the steps I need to take for any mishaps with our pool and equipment. Very happy customer!!
reviews.author: l Prickett

reviews.text: I messaged this company about an issue we were having with our pool pump. They called me within 15 minutes and scheduled a technician to come out that day but he came out within 30 minutes of our initial phone call. Will recommend to anyone. Great service and the technician was very informative and gave great tips.
reviews.author: Scott Remillard

reviews.text: Had repairs done. Perfect! Trustworthy! I Can’t recommend a better company to service your pool. The technician was friendly and got our pool running again!! We appreciate the work and how efficient and knowledgeable MD pool was during our repair process! Thank you!
reviews.author: Fisher Juhn

reviews.text: MD Pool Service has consistently been my preferred choice for pool maintenance. Their team is known for their professionalism, quick responsiveness, and consistently excellent work. I wouldn't think of turning to anyone else for my pool needs!
reviews.author: Alex Czapla

reviews.text: I would have given a 5 star review but really need to work on communication between customers. They do great work and rectified the situation we had, however communication is lacking a bit between customers, tech is very knowledgeable and would recommend using them.
reviews.author: Tina Flynn

reviews.text: I highly endorse the exceptional business ethics of the amiable team at MD Pools. The office administration staff has exhibited remarkable patience and understanding. Our partnership with them will undoubtedly continue, and we strongly encourage you to give them the opportunity to impress you as well.
reviews.author: Courtyard Marriott

reviews.text: These people are the real deal!Profesional and knowledgeable. And they stand on their word! I am so impressed with MD POOLS that I'm going to have them to expand and repair my waterfall feature next. I can hardly wait to see the end result! I trust them and you can too
reviews.author: Ray Moore

reviews.text: Great work , I highly recommend them and fast thank you guys
reviews.author: Manuel Gutierrez

reviews.text: Excellent and knowledgeable and efficient.  Finally found a well professional and dependable, detailed and supportive team to work with.   Mark is awesome.
reviews.author: Sonya Valadez

reviews.text: They have been superb from the beginning even was able to help with repairs on sidewall of our pool.  Will do before and after once finished.
reviews.author: Tachary O'Neill

reviews.text: Marc was nice and friendly. Easy to talk to.
reviews.author: Ishola Psalem

reviews.text: Constantly finding additional things to charge for without prior authorization.  Broke a part and claimed it was already broken.  Terrible responsiveness and terrible customer service.  Why is it so hard to provide a service professionally and ethically?
reviews.author: Jeff Wildman

reviews.text: Cannot recommended a better pool service in Red Oak, Texas!! The tech was friendly and very knowledgeable. Spoke with the office manger and everything was smooth and efficient.
reviews.author: Jacinta Donahue

reviews.text: Mark was professional who diagnosed my problem almost immediately.  I can't be happier.  Keep up the good work Mark.
reviews.author: Tsp2020

reviews.text: I would recommend them for pool cleaning and in any general service need. Consumaste gentlemen with military level discipline. They are not only pool boys, they are pool brothers. You’re missing out using any other service.
reviews.author: Luke Spicer

reviews.text: Great work, and quick to service. I would highly recommend using their pool services.
reviews.author: Connor O'Brien

reviews.text: They have done great work for my customers! I recommend them to everyone in the Midlothian, Cedar Hill, DeSoto, Waxahachie and surrounding area!
reviews.author: Cornelius Donahue

reviews.text: Ben was very professional and really made the whole process simple and stress free. I would definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Patrick Dhooghe

reviews.text: Our pool guy is very nice, helpful as well as j knowledgeable. Thanks and Merry Christmas!
reviews.author: Mary Plyler

reviews.text: These guys are the real deal..I was able to enjoy pool again thanks too MD Pool Service
reviews.author: Derrick Rushing

reviews.text: First time pool cleaning. Pool has never looked cleaner after cleaning.
reviews.author: Gary Jones

reviews.text: This company is punctual, communicates well, and provides great service!
reviews.author: Peter Arnold

reviews.text: They did a good job all the time
reviews.author: David Smith

reviews.text: Great service pool always looks great!!!
reviews.author: Barry Jenkins

reviews.text: Excellent costumer service!! Highly recommended!!
reviews.author: Yuliana Becker

reviews.text: Repair. Nice, friendly technician
reviews.author: Tammy R Clark

reviews.text: Can't say enough about this company and how great the are.
reviews.author: Stormi Steele

reviews.text: Very professional and proficient.
reviews.author: Kai

reviews.text: These guys are the real deal! I’m so glad I decided to reach out. Their prices are good, their service is excellent, the workers are kind, and the job is always well done. This is the American dream. Happy to support a Veteran-owned small business!
reviews.author: ZelieLouisa

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The positive reviews are detailed, varied, and credible. The negative reviews highlight specific, plausible issues (communication, billing) that are common in service industries and do not suggest systemic fraud like ghosting after payment. The high volume of detailed positive reviews against a few specific negatives indicates a generally reputable contractor with some areas for improvement in customer service.
